g.text: MarieRank4Convo2 begins.
Check boolean DrifterFaithStop
Drifter ! Bonjour ! I have discovered something most incredible, and I must tell you about it.
true
Marie, may I ask a personal question?
false
Why do you choose to worship Sol?
false
[End.]
false
Oh?
[End.]
Check boolean DrifterMarie
Evaluate expressions
Chat ends.
Oui ! Did you know that when I am fully in flight, I am impossible à voir ?! Je suis invisible !
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
true
+5 Chemistry
false
You told me you have a faith similar to mine, non ? Why do you believe ?
DrifterFaithYesSimilar
You told me you have a faith, though it was different from mine, it was faith all the same. Why do you believe ?
DrifterFaithYesForeign
I know you said your faith is personal to you, much like une histoire of your own making, but it is faith all the same. Why do you believe ?
DrifterFaithPersonal
Why do you ?
DrifterFaithSol
I could ask you the same of Lua, non ? Why do you believe ?
DrifterFaithLua
Why Sol, in particular ? Over Lua or perhaps the balance you adhere to ? A very good question. Why do you believe ?
DrifterFaithBalance
What gives me my certainty, you wonder ? Where you say we cannot know the universe ?
DrifterFaithAgnostic
As someone who follows no faith, I could see why that could seem strange, oui.
DrifterFaithNoFear
DrifterFaithNoMaybe
DrifterFaithNoMITW
What gives me my certainty, you wonder ?
false
Do you know what this means ?!
Oui ! I am unfond of cut flowers. If you wish to get me a gift, I pray it will not be roses in a vase.
Pour toi ? Bien sûr.
I... suppose I feel obligated to.
I wasn't really being honest with you when I told you that answer.
I had an experience. It changed my life.
Nothing ever happened, it's just something I've felt. It's guided me.
I want to believe. Therefore, I do.
I fear my answer may disappoint you, wolf. There has been no great miracle. No rays from the skies that shone down upon me.
"Why does this sensible young woman believe in things that I do not think are real, that seems silly," non ?
No?
Should I be worried?
How did you guess that was what I was going to ask? That's amazing.
That... wasn't what I was going to ask, but I will keep it in mind, thank you!
Why do you believe in Sol?
[End.]
Check boolean DrifterFaithNoPeace
Oui ? I am curious, why did you lie ?
Then I am jealous ! Most are not so lucky to have an event they can point to that is so ferme, oui ?
Ah, then our answers are the same. I have never known un miracle, save perhaps le Cardinal's arrival to the Cathédrale.
Check boolean DrifterFaithNoPeace
Non, I have always simply felt as though there has been a présence in my life that has been there to guide me. A benefactor that smiles and points when I reach the crossroads, nothing more.
Honestly? Yes, kind of. I didn't want to phrase it that way, though.
I was more wondering if there was an event, or... a moment that led to it.
Neither do I ! But the possibilities are now endless !
Peut-être ! Because the possibilities are now endless !
Because the devil told me you were going to.
Oh ! Oh, forgive me ! I am sorry. What is it that you wished to ask ? Et maintenant, je suis mortifiée...
Chat ends.
And you say it does not bring you much peace... this breaks my heart.
true
I will not tell you what to do. And I will not tell you what roads to seek.
false
I'm not sure, to be blunt. It was impulsive.
I thought it might be a way to get to know you better...
But your question was about why I believe, and I was quite rude in turning it about-face, je m'excuse.
Even then, that was an act of man and science, not the Luminaries, non ? This sérum that gave me the gift of flight -
But you say it does not bring you much peace ? This breaks my heart...
true
I think your faith may be the strongest of them all, non ?
false
You wouldn't call Entrati's serum a miracle?
Not even Lyon's voices? Or the Indifference?
Oh, thinking me silly for believing in the Luminaries is one of the most polite things you can think about someone with a differing faith.
The devil should be very afraid ! Beware, evil one ! The light shall smite thee from above !
Non, non, non... You were not going to ask me that, were you ? Ah !! Je vais lui faire bouffer un de ces livres !
For I am a poor shelter in this Void storm in which you have found yourself.
I do not know what instinct drove you to tell me such things. But I am glad you have spoken the truth, now.
Oh... you did not need to tell me such things to know me.
It is the product of a man. But I believe that it was Sol who guided our roads to come together as one.
It sounds to me as though you wander in the woods, desperately seeking a trail that you wish to be there.
To walk the trail in the woods simply with the hope in your heart to lead the way ?
It could be, I do not know. Perhaps the devil is right, and they it is all product of science we do not yet understand. The two are not exclusive, non ?
It offends me none, and I am glad for your honesty, always.
+20 Chemistry
What is it that you wished to ask ? Et maintenant, je suis mortifiée...
But I wonder if you do not find yourself upon a crossroads, and you may wish to think upon which way to go, non ?
A soul is more than the faith they wear. I am une Sœur de Sol, but I would hope you see more than that in me, non ?
That is why I believe. I feel Sol beside me when I arrive at the places when I am most unsure. I shut my eyes et il est là, to guide me.
I do not know if you will ever find it, but I pray that you will. For what you might discover there will be un miracle.
That is beautiful...
Sainte Mère Sol, vous avez béni votre fille aujourd'hui ! HA-HA !!
Obligation is no reason to believe. It only breeds doubt at best, and hollow contempt at worst.
There are as many topics that we could choose as there are stars in the sky !
That's beautiful.
Has he ever failed to guide you?
I wish I had that...
Chat ends.
Faith should be a balm to the soul. Not a crutch nor an excuse.
Do you forgive me, then?
I'm sorry. It was a silly thing to do.
Oui, and I know I am lucky. And it is a peace that is easy to seek to impose upon others, whether or not they want to have it.
Oui, many times. And in those moments, I reflect upon why. Perhaps I am meant to simply find my own way, non ? Ou peut-être que je suis une folle après tout, hah ! We are not always meant to know.
Oui, and I pray that you will have it some day. But it is not something that can be given or taught, it is something that must be found.
Update boolean DrifterCrossroads
Oui, I forgive you. If you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment.
Oui, and if you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment ! But you are not. And you are forgiven.
But as long as I am harming no one with my beliefs, I see no harm in holding them, oui ?
Within or without, where it may lay is different for everyone.
Update boolean DrifterFaithBalance
One thing has become clear to me though as of late.
Update boolean DrifterFaithYesForeign
What?
Oh?
Update boolean DrifterFaithYesSimilar
+15 Chemistry
Update boolean DrifterFaithSol
I am growing to also have faith in you.
Update boolean DrifterFaithPersonal
Fie ! I must go. The devil is eager to use this contraption. À la revoyure !
Update boolean DrifterFaithLua
Chat ends.
